title: Universal ranks and evaluation for a module pulled back from the base
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], with universally invertible structure-sheaf adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $\mathcal E$ be finite locally free on $X$ [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], $g:T\to S$, and $N$ finite locally free on $T$. If $q^*\mathcal E\cong p^*N$ [def-pc-module-pullback] for the base-change projections, then $P(f,\mathcal E,g)$ holds [def-sc-picard-direct-image-rank-condition], and the canonical counit $p^*p_*q^*\mathcal E\to q^*\mathcal E$ is invertible. This theorem asserts only a necessary condition for descent and constructs no representing scheme.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-finite-locally-free-tensor-unit] to p = pullback.snd f g and N using hO g. Its invertible unit gives N isomorphic to p_*q^*E by composing the unit isomorphism with the inverse pushforward of e. Transport finite local freeness along this isomorphism using [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. The adjunction triangle identity [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] expresses the counit at p^*N as the inverse of p^* applied to the unit. Counit naturality along e then proves the counit at q^*E invertible by cancelling e.
Apply [lem-sc-picard-pullback-local-ranks] to the original pullback presentation. This gives exactly the universal pointwise common-rank conjunct of PicardDirectImageRankCondition.

Apply [lem-sc-picard-pullback-base-change] to the same presentation. This gives the two canonical base-change isomorphisms for every further base morphism. Pair these with the finite direct-image freeness and the common-rank conjunct, unfold the rank condition, and pair it with the counit isomorphism already proved.

mathlib_searches.query: A finite locally free module pulled back from the base has the same rank as its direct image and invertible adjunction counit when the structure sheaf pushforward is universally trivial
If the pushforward of the structure sheaf is universally trivial then the adjunction unit on a finite locally free sheaf is an isomorphism and the counit on its pullback is an isomorphism

theorem picard_rankCondition_and_isIso_counit_of_pullback {X S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hO : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : T' ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g'))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T'.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S) (N : T.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (e : Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E ≅
      (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj N)) :
    PicardDirectImageRankCondition f E g ∧
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).counit.app
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E))
